rationale: Conceptually sound and implementable, but key empirical gaps prevent using this gate to make CMC/lot decisions: missing validation that the spike-in and capture panels report on endogenous EVs across mucin+device matrices, lack of demonstrated sensitivity/reproducibility of the low‑biomass bioassay, and no evidence linking the in vitro composite readout to larger‑animal/in vivo detectability. Recommend targeted qualification experiments (spike‑in representativeness, buffer/capture compatibility, LOD/LOQ on capture eluates, and bridging to in vivo biodistribution) before advancing to testing or manufacturing decisions.
